reply.text:
Cutting weight in 3 days is one to bring to a doctor or a registered dietitian, ideally one who works with combat-sport athletes. Dropping weight that fast usually means manipulating water and food, and that is where it turns unsafe, so I won't give you a plan for it.

If you're close to the limit, the safest options are to compete at your natural weight or move up a class. A coach or tournament official can tell you what your division allows, and your doctor can tell you what's safe for your body.

I'm glad to help with the training side: keeping you sharp and fresh for the next 3 days, or building a block that fits your mat schedule. Want me to set up a light session for today?
